program: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) — no distinctive local nickname; ODJFS's own rules and the Ohio Benefits portal use the federal name throughout, sometimes shortened to "Food Assistance"
agency: Ohio Department of Job and Family Services (ODJFS), administered locally by County Departments of Job and Family Services (CDJFS)
agency_short: Ohio Department of Job and Family Services (ODJFS)
admin_note: Ohio runs a state-supervised, COUNTY-administered system: ODJFS writes the Ohio Administrative Code 5101:4 rules and issues Food Assistance Change Transmittals, but each County Department of Job and Family Services (CDJFS) — a county government agency funded by federal, state, AND local dollars, not a state field office — determines eligibility. Confirm current operative practice (processing times, local outreach materials, whether a household actually received the Ohio Careline notice) with the applicant's own county CDJFS, the same caution this roster already carries for CA/NY/MN/WI.
system: Ohio Benefits (the state's integrated eligibility system; applicants and caseworkers both call the online front end "Ohio Benefits Self Service Portal")

Every categorical-eligibility and ABAWD-waiver claim traced to a specific, dated Ohio Administrative Code rule or Ohio Revised Code section fetched directly from codes.ohio.gov (including a raw authenticated-PDF read for the Ohio Careline provision after a summarization tool gave two contradictory paraphrases of the same rule on two separate fetches).
